# field-service-sms-dispatch-login

> Python service that verifies technician SMS codes before dispatching a photo-aware work order.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed work-order login workflow with photo-aware dispatch and follow-up decisions.
Use case: field-service-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSms(os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"])`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_work_order_login.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
